inputs.name: x
inputs.shape: NCHW dynamic, N=1, C=3, H/W multiples of 32

det.preprocess: RGB, resize long edge to a limit, /32-pad, x/255, then (x-mean)/std with ImageNet mean [0.485,0.456,0.406] std [0.229,0.224,0.225]
det.semantics: DB text probability map in [0,1]; binarise then contour/unclip to boxes

inputs.name: x
inputs.shape: NCHW, N=1, C=3, H=48, W dynamic

rec.preprocess: crop resized to height 48, x/255, then (x-0.5)/0.5 (no ImageNet mean/std)
rec.semantics: CTC logits; T = W/8 for input width W; class 0 = blank, classes 1..18383 = dict lines, class 18384 = space
